notes: Prices are the 2026 amounts from MICA's 2026 payment page. The main program page does not list tuition amounts. Prices for 2027 are not posted. The main page says to submit 6 pieces of work.
name: Pre-College Summer Intensive
what_you_do: Take art and design studio classes with MICA faculty, plus workshops and artist talks. Earn college credit. Choose a 2-week or 4-week option, living on campus or commuting.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 to 17. Apply with a portfolio of art or design work.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: residential $3,850 for 2 weeks or $7,700 for 4 weeks. Commuter $2,725 for 2 weeks or $5,450 for 4 weeks. Scholarships are available.
duration: 2 or 4 weeks (2026: about July 12 to Aug 8)
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are coming soon. Tuition is due only after acceptance.
how_to_apply: Online application (a fee applies), submit work samples, then deposit if accepted. Email precollege@mica.edu with questions.
